title: AgentDoc Cloud-Bound Validation Runtime Receipt
description: Digest-bound receipt returned by the pinned AgentDoc Validation Runtime when a Cloud source invocation is supplied. Deterministic by contract: stable ordering, no wall-clock timestamps, and an explicit evaluation_date. This JSON Schema is transport preflight only; the runtime remains the sole authoritative constructor.

runtime.description: Exact runtime identity: the release version of the invoking adoc surface and the harness-attested sha256 of its binary.

contract_versions.description: Consumed contract versions, keyed by contract role. 'graph' names the graph contract this runtime validates; semantic_context is present exactly when an adoc.semantic_context.v0 input is consumed.

evaluation_date.description: The explicit lifecycle evaluation date input. Mandatory so the receipt never depends on the wall clock.

inputs.description: Every compiled source input with its logical path and sha256 digest, in lexicographic path order.

context.description: Named validation-context inputs. source_invocation binds the exact Cloud manifest bytes read once by the runtime.

diagnostics_digest.description: sha256 over the canonically serialized typed diagnostics array.
